_comment: Source of truth for /compare. Edit here, or edit the Excel export and run output/import-comparison-xlsx.py. Cell rules: competitor values must come from that vendor's own documentation; use the legend vocabulary rather than inventing one; keep wording symmetrical across a row; bump checkedOn on any change.
legend: Not found in the vendor’s official documentation.
Official sources conflict; needs hands-on confirmation.

rows.label: License model
rows.cleanshot: One-time; 1 year of updates; 1 GB CleanShot Cloud included
rows.xnapper: One-time, perpetual use; 1 year of updates; renewal at 40% off
rows.sealshot: One-time, perpetual use; 18 months of updates at the founding price; $24 renewal

rows.label: Devices per individual license tier
rows.snagit: Unlimited installs; one active device at a time

rows.label: Screen recording
rows.snagit: Yes — microphone, system audio, webcam, GIF
rows.xnapper: Yes — fullscreen, region, or window; built-in video editor

rows.label: Automatic sensitive-data detection
rows.snagit: Yes — addresses, cards, dates, emails, faces, IPs, phones, SSNs, URLs
rows.xnapper: Yes — emails, cards, IPs, API keys
rows.sealshot: Yes — emails, cards, IDs, API keys

rows.label: Automatic redaction method in flattened exports
rows.cleanshot: No automatic mode — manual pixelate, secure or smooth blur, filled rectangle
rows.shottr: No automatic mode — manual blur, pixelation, object removal
rows.sealshot: Opaque solid fill; flattened into exported images

rows.label: App-managed local-library encryption
rows.sealshot: Optional app-managed AES-256-GCM; unlock with Touch ID, Apple Watch, or system password

rows.label: Account required
rows.cleanshot: No — cloud account “not required to use the app”
rows.snagit: Yes — TechSmith sign-in required to unlock

rows.label: Capture library
rows.sealshot: Yes — collections, tags, OCR full-text search

rows.label: Hosted sharing
rows.shottr: Shottr Cloud or your own S3 bucket

notes: Sealshot's solid fill is an annotation drawn over the image, and a .seal package keeps the original capture alongside it so that edits stay reversible. Redaction is therefore destroyed in a flattened export — PNG, JPEG, or a flattened package — but not inside an editable project. Send exports, not editable packages, when the content matters.
Per TechSmith's 2025 move to annual subscription pricing, for the individual plan. Business and volume licensing may differ.
Shottr's own documentation warns that its hosted links are public and are not secure storage.
Xnapper's homepage says cloud sharing is “coming soon” while its changelog says image and video sharing have shipped. Needs checking against the current build.
